# STRUCTIVA — Engineered Steel Structures

> STRUCTIVA is an international manufacturer and engineering firm specializing in clear-span arched steel buildings, pre-engineered steel buildings (PEB), and heavy structural steel fabrication. Operating from its integrated mega-facilities in Adana, Türkiye, with direct Mediterranean container port access, STRUCTIVA delivers certified bolted steel building kits to over 50 countries worldwide.

## Quick Facts
- **Headquarters & Mega-Plant**: Structiva Tesisleri, Organize Sanayi Bölgesi (AOSB), Adana, Türkiye
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.structiva.com.tr
- **Contact Email**: info@structiva.com.tr
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +90 532 055 09 45
- **Annual Capacity**: 25,000 Metric Tons of structural steel fabrication
- **International Shipping**: Flat-pack into standard 40HC ocean containers (~380 m² building per container) via Mediterranean deep-water ports (Mersin Port)

## Core Building Models & Specifications
- **Q-Series (Arch / Quonset Building)**:
  - Profile: Continuous semi-circular arch
  - Span Range: 9 m to 45 m (30 ft to 148 ft) column-free
  - Material: Galvalume Plus® AZ180 alloy steel (55% Al, 43.4% Zn)
  - Resistance: Up to 240 km/h wind velocity; severe snow loads up to 3.5 kN/m²
  - Applications: Aircraft & helicopter hangars, bulk agricultural grain silos, mining aggregate storage
- **S-Series (Straight Sidewall Arch)**:
  - Profile: Vertical straight side walls with arched roof
  - Span Range: 12 m to 30 m (40 ft to 100 ft)
  - Advantage: Maximum interior perimeter height for tall pallet racking and forklift operations
  - Applications: Logistics distribution centers, industrial manufacturing workshops, equipment depots
- **P-Series (Gable / Pitched Roof Arch)**:
  - Profile: Pitched gabled roof line with straight walls
  - Span Range: 10 m to 24 m (33 ft to 80 ft)
  - Applications: Commercial workshops, municipal maintenance garages, agricultural equipment barns
- **Container Canopy System**:
  - Profile: Arched structural truss mounted between standard 20ft or 40ft shipping containers
  - Span Range: 8 m to 20 m (26 ft to 66 ft)
  - Applications: Fast-deployment mining camps, construction site storage, container yard weather covers
- **Pre-Engineered Heavy Steel Buildings (PEB)**:
  - Profile: Tapered built-up I-beam portal frames with rigid knee joints
  - Span Range: Up to 60 m clear-span
  - Applications: Heavy factories, overhead crane facilities (up to 50-ton cranes), mega logistics parks

## Quality, Engineering & International Certifications
- **EN 1090-2:2018**: Execution Class EXC3 and EXC4 for load-bearing structural steel (CE Marking)
- **AISC 360-16**: American Institute of Steel Construction Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
- **ASTM A792 / A792M**: Standard Specification for Steel Sheet, 55% Aluminum-Zinc Alloy-Coated by the Hot-Dip Process
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management System for fabrication and static engineering
- **ISO 14001 & ISO 45001**: Environmental and Occupational Safety Standards
- **Zero Field Welding**: 100% pre-engineered, CNC laser-punched for high-tensile Grade 8.8/10.9 structural bolts

## Procurement & RFQ Process
1. **Requirements Submission**: Submit span, length, peak height, building purpose, and destination port via the online 3D Configurator or RFQ form.
2. **Engineering Review**: STRUCTIVA static engineers conduct load calculation (EN 1991-1-4 wind and Eurocode 3 snow load).
3. **Commercial Proposal**: Detailed Bill of Materials (BOM), 3D packaging layout, and FOB Mersin / CIF Destination quotation delivered within 24 hours.
